soldier: The soldier has the head, labrum and pronotum reddish yellow, the frons and mandibles reddish brown, antennae, legs and abdomen yellow. The head sparsely haired, the labrum and pronotum with rather more bristles, the abdominal tergites with sparse long bristles. Head capsule rectangular, rather stout and short, the sides slightly parallel, the frons slightly raised on either side and slightly depressed in the middle. Mandibles stout and short, the left with three marginal teeth, the right with two. Labrum elongate-oval, its anterior margin rounded and blunt, almost as long as wide. Antennae with ten segments, the third short and small. The postmentum widest slightly in front of the middle, narrowest at the anterior margin and at the waist, the greatest width less than twice the least. Pronotum shaped like a butterfly with spread wings, the anterior margin a broad concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.
